verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is a code-driven SDK (completion()) plus a self-hosted proxy. It has an official CLI with worker flags and a docker image, and offers curl-callable MCP REST endpoints, so it can run headlessly without any UI. Its documented mock_response mode lets automated tests run without calling LLM APIs, which supports CI use. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline recipes), documented non-interactive config/bootstrap for ephemeral CI runs, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
